sources.title: Longer Interset Rest Periods Enhance Muscle Strength and Hypertrophy in Resistance-Trained Men
sources.design: 8-week randomized comparison; 1 vs 3 minute interset rest
sources.finding: This trial reported greater squat and bench strength gains with 3-minute rest than 1-minute rest.
limitations: Full methods and attrition not yet reviewed
Does not establish 3 minutes as a universal optimum
Does not quantify an individual growth penalty for shortening one rest
sources.guidance_ko: 휴식을 짧게 줄이면 수행에 영향을 줄 수 있어요. 우선 현재 루틴이 정한 휴식과 실제로 쉰 시간을 비교해 주세요.

sources.title: Resistance Training Volume Enhances Muscle Hypertrophy but Not Strength in Trained Men
sources.design: 8 weeks, 3 sessions/week, 1 vs 3 vs 5 sets per exercise
sources.finding: No statistically significant between-group squat or bench strength differences; some hypertrophy outcomes favored higher volume.
limitations: Not proof that volumes are equivalent
Small completer sample and outcome-specific missing data
Does not validate increasing sets to resolve an individual plateau
Hypertrophy findings are not direct proof of greater powerlifting strength
sources.guidance_ko: 세트를 더 한다고 중량이 반드시 더 빨리 늘지는 않아요. 목표 횟수·중량·휴식을 먼저 확인하고 훈련량 변경은 별도로 판단해 주세요.

sources.title: Gaining more from doing less? The effects of a one-week deload period during supervised resistance training on muscular adaptations
sources.population: 50 randomized, 39 completed; trained adults, 29 men and 10 women among completers
sources.design: 9 weeks; complete resistance-training cessation in week 5 vs continuous training
sources.finding: No clear hypertrophy benefit; strength estimates favored continuous training but uncertainty intervals included zero.
limitations: Complete cessation is not reduced-load or reduced-volume deload
Does not establish an optimal response to an individual plateau
Smith-machine outcomes do not directly establish SBD competition changes
Unsupervised upper-body adherence uncertain; lower-body outcomes assessed
No individual benefit/harm probability is calculated
sources.guidance_ko: 이 연구만으로 정체 때마다 일주일 쉬라고 정할 수는 없어요. 완전 휴식과 훈련량을 줄이는 디로드도 구분해야 해요.
